decisions.reason: As a close extension of our established water-control offering, this product fits our existing engineering and service knowledge, so despite its recent launch and only limited website prominence we are likely to retain it and learn from early projects.

This energy management system builds directly on our software, infrastructure integration, and strategic move toward digitally networked and efficient water facilities, and our in-house R&D and research cooperation make continued development especially attractive.

This overflow flap gate is close to our core hydraulic infrastructure business and its dedicated webpage suggests active commercialization, so with our strong related knowledge we would be more likely to keep and refine it than to withdraw it.
